children: China's new home prices declined again in October, extending a years-long market slump that has eroded confidence, sapped consumer spending and squeezed local governments' incomes.
New home prices dipped 0.1% in October from the previous month, matching September's decline, according to Reuters calculations based on Monday's data from the National Bureau of Statistics.
From a year earlier, prices fell 2.4%, a smaller drop than September's fall of 2.8% and the slowest pace of decrease since November 2025.
